stories.description: New access reforms eliminate hostile reporting overnight.
stories.text: WASHINGTON — The White House announced Saturday that the United States has achieved 100 percent press freedom following implementation of new access standards that prevent troublesome members of the press from accessing the White House. Officials called the results historic. “For decades Americans were told a free press required journalists to question the government,” Press Secretary Amanda Liberty said. “Unfortunately, nobody stopped to ask whether the government enjoyed being questioned.” The reforms address that oversight. Under the new Presidential Press Freedom Protection Program , journalists remain completely free to report anything they wish. The administration remains equally free to determine whether those journalists are journalists, whether their journalism constitutes journalism, and whether allowing them near government officials might endanger journalism. The results were immediate. According to White House statistics, hostile questions inside the building have fallen 100 percent. Unfair follow-ups are down 100 percent. Administration officials caught contradicting themselves declined an astonishing 100 percent. Public confidence among reporters permitted into the building now stands at 100 percent. Officials credited the success to Evidence-Based Journalism , a revolutionary system under which media organizations repeatedly producing negative coverage are removed from the statistical sample until confidence improves. “This is science,” Liberty explained. Several patriotic media organizations applauded the reforms, noting that authoritarian governments suppress journalists, whereas the United States merely identifies journalists threatening freedom and prevents them from practicing journalism near the government. “That distinction is what separates America from dictatorships,” said constitutional analyst Brock Eagleton. “In North Korea the government controls the press. Here the press controls itself after the government explains what happens if it doesn’t.” CNN and other excluded organizations protested the policy, but administration officials said their objections actually demonstrated how much freedom remained. “They're criticizing us right now,” Liberty noted. “Would a dictatorship allow that?” Asked whether those organizations would regain White House access, Liberty smiled. “No.” Officials said additional press-freedom reforms are already under consideration. By next month, reporters attending briefings may submit questions electronically for advance approval. Journalists receiving three rejected questions will receive complimentary enrollment in a government seminar titled Understanding Why You're the Problem . The administration expects negative White House coverage to reach historic lows. Asked who would independently verify those numbers, Liberty appeared confused. “We already did.”
stories.title: AMERICA ACHIEVES PERFECT PRESS FREEDOM; WHITE HOUSE REPORTS ZERO NEGATIVE COVERAGE

stories.description: New ethics framework officially eliminates presidential corruption by classifying payments to family businesses as commerce.
stories.text: WASHINGTON — The White House announced Thursday that presidential corruption has effectively been eliminated in the United States following a historic modernization of the federal definition of bribery. Under the new standard, money given directly to a public official in exchange for government action will remain illegal. Money invested in financial products benefiting businesses associated with the president’s family while the president controls policy affecting those products will be classified as “commerce.” “This is an incredibly important distinction,” a senior administration official explained. “Bribery is when somebody gives you money and you promise them something. Commerce is when somebody gives you money and everybody remains mature enough not to discuss what happens next.” The reform arrives during an extraordinary period of financial innovation for the Trump family. The family’s World Liberty Financial crypto venture has attracted substantial foreign investment, including a $100 million token purchase by UAE-based Aqua 1 Foundation. Reuters reported that the purchase made Aqua 1 the largest publicly known investor in World Liberty at the time. Administration officials emphasized that such financial developments occurred while President Trump was exercising the completely separate powers of the presidency to reshape federal cryptocurrency policy. In January 2025, Trump signed an executive order establishing a presidential working group on digital assets and directing agencies to identify regulations and other actions affecting the sector that should be rescinded or modified. The White House described the policy as part of Trump's effort to make the United States the “crypto capital of the planet.” In March, Trump went further, signing an executive order establishing a Strategic Bitcoin Reserve and United States Digital Asset Stockpile. Officials stressed that government cryptocurrency policy and presidential-family cryptocurrency wealth occupy entirely separate ethical universes, despite occasionally occupying the same industry. The administration cited the President’s $TRUMP meme coin as another breakthrough in clean government. In 2025, Trump hosted a dinner for the coin’s 220 largest holders, with additional access offered to the biggest investors. The Associated Press reported on the dinner and the resulting conflict-of-interest and transparency concerns. AP separately reported that the $TRUMP operation had generated more than $320 million in fees and that the pseudonymous nature of cryptocurrency raised questions about who could be buying access. The top 220 holders qualified for dinner with the president, while the top 25 qualified for an additional reception. “That is the beauty of blockchain,” explained Deputy Assistant Secretary for Things That Are Technically Different. “With old-fashioned corruption, investigators wasted years following the money. Now the money can move first and everyone can argue about what it meant afterward.” The reforms have attracted significant international interest. Reuters has documented the rapid expansion of the Trump family’s global crypto business, including significant participation by foreign investors and the use of World Liberty’s USD1 stablecoin in a $2 billion Binance investment involving Abu Dhabi’s MGX. Reuters called it the Trump family’s “global crypto cash machine.” Ethics specialists and lawmakers have raised concerns about conflicts between presidential authority and the Trump family’s crypto interests. Administration officials have rejected accusations of wrongdoing and conflicts of interest. White House officials noted that nobody has produced a receipt reading ONE FOREIGN-POLICY FAVOR — PAID IN FULL. “That would be corruption,” the official said. Instead, foreign governments, billionaires and investors remain free to place enormous amounts of money into ventures benefiting the president’s family while simultaneously maintaining interests before the United States government. “What happens after that is foreign policy,” he explained. The White House expects the new definition to produce dramatic improvements in federal ethics statistics. “Under the old system, people saw conflicts everywhere,” the official said. “Under this system, there can’t be a conflict unless somebody actually calls it one.” Officials predict presidential corruption could reach zero by Christmas. Markets rallied on the news.
stories.title: WHITE HOUSE ANNOUNCES HISTORIC SEPARATION OF MONEY AND CORRUPTION

stories.text: WASHINGTON — Vice President JD Vance announced Thursday that the administration will abandon traditional midterm campaigning and instead spend the next seven weeks standing outside America's house asking her to please come down and talk. The nationwide JUST ONE MORE CHANCE, BABY TOUR begins Friday in Pennsylvania, where Vance will arrive shortly after midnight carrying grocery-store roses, a stuffed bear and several handwritten pages explaining that the last two years weren't entirely his fault. “America, baby, open the door,” Vance is expected to tell voters. “I know you're in there. Patel then clarified that the FBI welcomed qualified Americans from diverse backgrounds but maintained “very high standards regarding livestock.” Asked what those standards were, Patel looked toward an aide. The aide looked toward the floor. At press time, the FBI had suspended the campaign after discovering its new recruitment website had become the number-one Google result for GOATFUCKERS WITH SECURITY CLEARANCE . A hotel housekeeper recalled finding the mannequin seated beside Miller's bed facing a television tuned to immigration coverage. “There were candles,” she said. “And some kind of massage oil.” Miller strongly denied using the oil on Tradition. “The oil was unrelated,” he said. The thought that follows is fragmentation.” Public response has been mixed. stories.text: WASHINGTON, DC — President Donald Trump awarded his sons a massive no-bid contract from Iran Tuesday after blaming U.S. naval support vessels for the rising price of oil. The contract authorizes Trump Maritime Solutions LLC to commandeer American carrier groups and conduct bombing operations against fuel ships, supply vessels, ammunition transports, repair crews, and any boat “looking logistical.” Trump defended the arrangement as a bold anti-inflation measure. “Nobody talks about the support vessels,” Trump said. “Very nasty ships. Very expensive. They carry fuel, they carry food, they carry little parts, nobody knows what the parts are. Maybe that’s why oil is high. Maybe they’re drinking it. I don’t know. A lot of people are saying it.” Administration officials said Donald Trump Jr. and Eric Trump were uniquely qualified because both had extensive experience standing near military hardware at campaign events. Under the agreement, the brothers will receive performance bonuses for every naval support vessel destroyed, with premium incentives for attacks that reduce readiness, confuse allies, or generate emergency supplemental funding. Pentagon officials initially expressed concern before being reminded the contract was technically foreign-funded and therefore “basically free.” Within hours of taking operational control, Trump Maritime Solutions identified six oilers, three ammunition ships, and one hospital vessel as “deep state floating price manipulators.” All were immediately reclassified as hostile infrastructure. Eric Trump reportedly approved the first strike after mistaking a fleet replenishment map for a seafood menu. Donald Trump Jr. praised the mission as “the future of asymmetric entrepreneurship.” “Iran gets results, we get paid, Dad gets to say he lowered support-vessel dependency,” Junior said. “That’s called peace through monetization.” White House economists later claimed the destruction of support ships would lower oil prices by reducing the number of ships capable of requesting oil. “Demand is demand,” one adviser explained. “If a ship no longer exists, its fuel needs have been permanently solved.” Navy commanders warned that carrier groups were beginning to run short on food, fuel, parts, ammunition, and operational purpose. The White House called this proof of efficiency. Iranian military officials, meanwhile, appeared stunned by the speed of the program. “We were hoping to destroy maybe three ships this year,” admitted one Iranian commander. “These people are visionaries.”
stories.title: Trump Awards Sons Iranian No-Bid Contract To Bomb U.S. Naval Support Vessels

stories.description: The new Chicago-born pontiff appears to be losing a feud he did not know he was in.
stories.text: 1:43 A.M., TRUTH SOCIAL — It began, as these things now do, with a post. In a late-night blast that lit up phones, feeds, and several group chats that were supposed to be quiet, Donald J. Trump declared total war on what he described as a growing scandal involving Pope Leo XIV—a scandal that, until that exact moment, had not been observed by anyone else. “DISASTER!” Trump wrote, attaching an image he called “100% REAL PROOF” of Leo’s supposed ties to radical elements. The photo—now circulating at speed—appears to show the Chicago-born pontiff seated among red-clad figures in a graffiti-lined setting. Some observers have gently suggested the image might not be entirely authentic. Those observers were immediately outrun by the post itself. Within minutes, the narrative was set. Trump didn’t just criticize Leo—he defined him. “Lowlife LIBERAL stooge,” the post continued, marking the Pope’s rapid transition from global religious leader to active combatant in a feud he has not acknowledged, entered, or been formally invited to. The Vatican has declined to respond. Sources indicate Pope Leo spent the evening engaged in routine papal duties, including prayer, counsel, and not being in a street crew photo. Officials describe the situation as “not a situation,” though they admit they are now monitoring it as one. Back in the United States, however, the momentum is unmistakable. Supporters have embraced the framing wholesale, treating Trump’s post as both revelation and verdict. “He exposed him,” said one man, declining to specify what exactly had been exposed. “You can just tell.” As of this morning, Pope Leo XIV remains the head of the Catholic Church, a position traditionally associated with spiritual authority, moral guidance, and now—apparently—losing a fight on the internet he did not know he was in.
stories.title: Trump Blasts Pope Leo In Late-Night Truth Social Post

stories.description: Federal officials defended the destruction of the Pope’s ceremonial vehicle as a necessary demonstration of border seriousness after papal criticism of deportation raids.
stories.text: CHICAGO — Federal tensions between President Trump and the Vatican spiraled Thursday after heavily armed ICE tactical agents surrounded and demolished the Pope’s ceremonial Popemobile outside O’Hare International Airport in what administration officials described as “a necessary demonstration of border seriousness.” The operation began shortly after Pope Leo XIV criticized recent deportation raids during a Vatican livestream viewed by nearly four million Catholics and at least twelve extremely angry men inside a Buffalo Wild Wings outside Joliet. Witnesses said black-clad agents emerged from unmarked SUVs carrying breaching tools, riot shields, and industrial spray paint before methodically smashing the vehicle’s armored glass enclosure while tactical drones circled overhead broadcasting Lee Greenwood songs at psychologically destabilizing volume. “They treated it like they were taking Fallujah,” said one airport janitor who watched the operation unfold from behind a floor buffer. “One guy yelled ‘THIS IS WHAT HAPPENS WHEN YOU HARBOR COMPASSION’ before putting a pickaxe through the windshield.” Footage of the destruction dominated cable news throughout the evening as administration allies defended the operation as “a measured response to escalating papal rhetoric.” White House Press Secretary Tanner Rusk addressed reporters hours later beneath a massive electronic border wall graphic. “The Pope is entitled to his opinion,” Rusk explained calmly. “But when foreign religious leaders begin undermining lawful deportation infrastructure, the United States government must respond with strength, clarity, and federally coordinated windshield destruction.” President Trump later referenced the incident during a rally in Tulsa where supporters waved signs reading MAKE ROME GREAT AGAIN. “I love Catholics,” Trump told the cheering crowd. “Fantastic people. Beautiful candles. But this Pope? Very unfair. Very nasty to ICE. Frankly the Popemobile got very aggressive with our agents.” The Vatican condemned the attack as “an act of intimidation incompatible with democratic governance,” though several administration surrogates immediately dismissed the statement as “open-border propaganda from robe globalists.” At press time, federal officials confirmed the destroyed Popemobile would be listed Friday on GovDeals.com.
stories.title: Trump Escalates War on Pope: ICE Agents Destroy Popemobile as Warning

stories.description: The former president says Americans are using weak math and should focus on the feeling of the number.
stories.text: PALM BEACH, FL — With oil prices climbing above $100 a barrel this week, President Donald Trump assured Americans that energy costs are “lower than they’ve ever been,” provided they are evaluated under what he described as a “more accurate and very strong way of thinking about numbers.” “People see $100 and they panic,” Trump said during remarks delivered beside a decorative pump he identified as “symbolic of dominance.” “But what they don’t understand is that it’s actually extremely low. Some are saying possibly the lowest ever, when you look at it correctly.” Trump clarified that traditional pricing models fail to account for what he called “American energy confidence,” a variable he said reduces the real cost of oil “sometimes all the way down to zero, or very close to it.” “If you feel strong about it, if the country feels strong, the number changes,” he said. “In many cases, it becomes free. We had oil that was basically free. People don’t talk about that.” Energy analysts initially attempted to reconcile the statement with current market data, before several shifted to describing the remarks as “conceptually priced.” According to Trump, the key lies in understanding that high prices often reflect strength rather than cost. “When oil is high, that means we’re respected,” he explained. “And when you’re respected, you’re not really paying. You’re gaining. So it’s a very low price, maybe even a negative price when you think about it.” The president also suggested Americans focus less on the numeric figure itself and more on the “feeling of the number,” which he described as “tremendous right now.” “People are doing their calculations all wrong,” Trump said. “They’re using weak math. We use strong math. Strong math says it’s low. Very low. Possibly free.” At the conclusion of his remarks, Trump reiterated that his administration had achieved “the best oil pricing in history,” adding that any apparent increases were “optical and, frankly, optional.” “Don’t look at the number,” he advised. “Look at what the number is telling you to feel.”
stories.title: Trump Explains $100 Oil Is “Effectively Free,” Urges Americans to Adjust Perspective

stories.description: Former president calls unprecedented hands-on voter appreciation program “probably the greatest loyalty reward in political history.”
stories.text: PALM BEACH, FLORIDA — Donald Trump announced Thursday that every American who has ever voted for him will receive a complimentary one-hour massage from Melania Trump, unveiling what campaign officials described as the largest spouse-based voter rewards program in American history. “Nobody has ever done this for their voters,” Trump said. “Lincoln didn't do it. Reagan didn't do it. They didn't have Melania, frankly. Very beautiful hands. Strong hands. People tell me fantastic hands.” According to campaign officials, eligible voters will receive 60 minutes of massage, although the fine print limits actual physical contact to 52 minutes after mandatory check-in, waiver execution, and an eight-minute presentation on Trump-branded orthopedic pillows. Melania reportedly learned of the program shortly before the announcement. “I am not want to rub all the dirties,” she said, shrugging. “But is in contract.” The campaign estimates roughly 75 million Americans may qualify, requiring Melania to perform continuous massages for approximately 8,560 years. Trump disputed the arithmetic. “Fake numbers,” he said. “She works very fast.” Campaign planners said the program, officially named HANDS ACROSS AMERICA AGAIN , will begin with voters in key states before expanding nationwide. Supporters can select Swedish, deep tissue, or “Patriot,” a proprietary technique officials declined to describe except to say it concludes with the recipient standing for the national anthem. Voters were ecstatic. “I've supported that man through four indictments, two impeachments and nine hundred emails asking me for seventeen dollars,” said Gary Puckett, 61, of Ohio. “It's nice somebody finally gives something back.” Puckett said he planned to request lower-back work. Others were already thinking bigger. “I voted Trump three times,” said Linda Crenshaw, 68, clutching printed screenshots of her voting history. “That's three hours. I'm not leaving that table until democracy has been honored.” Asked whether his own wife had agreed to potentially several millennia of compulsory bodywork, Trump dismissed the question. “Melania loves the voters. Loves them. Maybe not touching them so much. But spiritually, tremendous love.” At press time, campaign lawyers were reviewing Melania's contract while Melania was reportedly reviewing flights to Slovenia.
stories.title: TRUMP OFFERS EVERY SUPPORTER ONE FREE HOUR OF MASSAGE FROM MELANIA

stories.description: Officials say Patriot Spine will correct ideological hesitation, empathy, compromise, and insufficient applause intensity.
stories.text: WASHINGTON, D.C. — Following another week of embarrassing murmurs from congressional Republicans who briefly experimented with “independent thought,” President Donald Trump unveiled Patriot Spine™, a revolutionary new loyalty enhancement chip now mandatory for all elected Republicans, senior aides, and “problematic podcast people.” Standing beneath twelve American flags and one enormous framed photograph of himself looking wet in a hurricane, Trump called the technology “the biggest advancement in patriotism since the flag, maybe bigger.” “We had weak people,” Trump explained during the two-hour announcement rally carried live across all loyal networks. “Very weak. Sad weakness. They’d go on television and say things like, ‘Maybe we should read the bill first,’ or ‘Perhaps threatening civil war is not optimal messaging.’ Totally unacceptable behavior. Frankly, very mentally ill.” The Patriot Spine system, developed by defense contractor LibertyDyne Solutions in partnership with the Department of American Vibes, delivers corrective electrical shocks whenever Republican officials display symptoms of ideological hesitation, empathy, compromise, or insufficient applause intensity. Demonstrations for reporters showed the chip activating almost instantly after one Iowa congressman quietly asked whether tariffs might increase consumer prices. Witnesses described the man convulsing violently before apologizing to a framed photo of Trump and screaming, “THE MARKETS DEMAND STRENGTH.” Approval among MAGA voters reportedly surged after rollout footage aired during Patriot Sunrise with host Buckley Dane, who described the implants as “finally bringing accountability back to freedom.” At a rally afterward, supporters celebrated the new system enthusiastically. “If your spine can’t support Trump,” said rally attendee Dale Rickenbocker while purchasing a commemorative Patriot Spine steak knife set, “then frankly you don’t deserve one.” Inside Congress, installation clinics have already begun operating around the clock. Sources say several lawmakers volunteered early after learning the enhanced model includes Bluetooth compatibility with Truth Social notifications and emergency anti-woke adrenaline injections. Trump closed the event by reassuring Americans the program was “totally optional,” before clarifying that Republicans declining implantation would immediately be classified as Antifa-adjacent “spiritually transgender globalists.” Shares in LibertyDyne rose 480 percent before markets halted trading due to what federal regulators described as “extremely patriotic volatility.”
stories.title: Trump Orders Loyalty Chips Installed In Republican Spines

stories.description: Administration calls flooded National Mall detention site “a beautiful compromise between security and tourism.”
stories.text: WASHINGTON, DC — President Donald Trump ordered the Reflecting Pool drained Tuesday and converted into an “emergency patriotic containment zone” for undocumented migrants, political agitators, and “people giving weird vibes around monuments,” according to newly expanded executive powers announced during a press conference beside the Lincoln Memorial. Construction crews worked overnight installing chain-link fencing, portable floodlights, and thousands of numbered lawn chairs directly inside the empty concrete basin stretching between the Lincoln Memorial and the Washington Monument. Trump defended the move while gesturing proudly toward several thousand confused detainees standing ankle-deep in mud beneath rotating surveillance drones. “You know what Lincoln liked? Strength,” Trump explained. “Very underrated strength guy. People don’t know that about him because the woke historians hide it.” Officials described the new facility as an “open-air freedom processing campus” designed to reduce overcrowding while preserving “iconic American sightlines.” “It reflects freedom,” Trump continued. “That’s why it’s called the Reflecting Pool.” Behind him, workers hurriedly assembled additional razor wire after several detainees attempted to escape through a Smithsonian gift shop. The Department of Homeland Security insisted conditions inside the Pool remained humane despite mounting complaints regarding sanitation, heat exhaustion, and the increasingly aggressive seagulls circling overhead. “They gave us numbered floaties this morning,” said one detainee from Honduras. “I honestly cannot tell if this is temporary or symbolic.” Another detainee reported guards instructing prisoners to “face Lincoln respectfully during meal periods.” “At night they project giant eagles onto the water mist,” he said. “One guard told us if we stared at the memorial long enough we became citizens again.” Tourists continued visiting the National Mall throughout the day, many stopping to take selfies beside the detention fencing while vendors sold commemorative “Freedom Pool” snow globes and souvenir life jackets. The White House later clarified that the Reflecting Pool facility is not technically a camp because “the presence of water infrastructure creates an entirely different legal atmosphere.” At press time, administration officials confirmed plans to expand patriotic detention capacity further by converting the Lincoln Memorial itself into a “temporary vertical holding solution.”
stories.title: Trump Orders Mass Detentions In Empty Reflecting Pool: “Lincoln Would’ve Wanted Strong Borders”

stories.description: White House officials say president’s “instinctive alpha communication style” immediately destabilized Xi Jinping psychologically.
stories.text: BEIJING — President Donald Trump opened high-level trade negotiations with Chinese President Xi Jinping Tuesday by pulling the corners of his eyes back with both index fingers and loudly announcing, “OH! ROOK AT ME! I SO CHI-NEE TOO!” according to stunned officials present inside the summit chamber. Administration aides later described the maneuver as “an intentionally unpredictable cultural power play designed to establish psychological leverage.” “The president understands that weakness is predictable,” explained Secretary of State Brent Hallowmere. “Traditional diplomacy says don’t insult foreign leaders immediately. Trump flipped the board. Xi never saw it coming.” Witnesses reported the president spent the first nine minutes of the summit speaking in what aides described as “combat Mandarin,” consisting primarily of the words: “CHINA,” “BING BONG,” and “VERY RESPECT.” At one point Trump allegedly pointed toward a decorative lacquer bowl before asking Xi if it contained “the little crunchy noodles from the airport.” Chinese officials reportedly remained expressionless throughout the exchange, though one interpreter briefly removed his earpiece and stared silently into the middle distance for several seconds. The White House later characterized the summit opening as “a masterclass in disruptive negotiation architecture.” “Sun Tzu says appear insane when you are strong,” said Commerce Secretary Dean Rollins while standing beside a graphic reading: TRUMP: TOO ALPHA FOR ASIA. “He walked in culturally untethered. That’s dominance.” Sources inside the room claim Trump intensified the strategy by repeatedly complimenting Xi on “inventing karate” before challenging Chinese delegates to identify which Trump family member “had the best kung fu energy.” Negotiations reportedly reached a tense moment after Trump attempted to demonstrate “traditional Chinese respect customs” by bowing aggressively low and yelling “HONORRRR” loud enough to startle several security personnel. White House economic advisors later confirmed global markets reacted positively to the summit’s “high testosterone energy” before plunging sharply during Trump’s improvised attempt to rename Taiwan “Golf Island.” By evening, administration officials declared the summit a historic success after Xi reportedly spoke only eleven words during the entire session. “Totally rattled him,” Trump told reporters afterward. “The eye thing especially. Very strong move. Nobody’s ever opened China better than me.”
stories.title: Trump Praised For “Dominance-Based Diplomacy” After Opening China Summit With Racial Improvisation

stories.description: President confirms U.S. forces achieved overwhelming victory in a naval engagement he maintains did not occur, calling the outcome “a flawless execution of a war that isn’t happening.”
stories.text: WASHINGTON, D.C. — Declaring his signature Schrödinger’s War Model “an absolute masterpiece,” Donald Trump opened remarks Monday by praising the administration’s handling of a U.S. naval clash with Iran that he emphasized “never took place.” “It’s working perfectly,” Trump said. “We’ve got a war that’s not a war. Nobody’s ever seen anything like it. Very advanced. Very smart. And we’re winning it—big—despite the fact that it didn’t happen.” The comments follow confirmed reports of U.S. forces engaging Iranian vessels in the Strait of Hormuz, an encounter Trump dismissed as “fake news” even as he highlighted the military’s “incredible performance” during the non-event. “There was no clash,” he continued. “Totally made up. But if there was, we destroyed them. Completely. Fast, clean, beautiful. Honestly, one of the best victories we’ve ever had in a situation that doesn’t exist.” Pentagon officials confirmed that U.S. helicopters and naval assets successfully neutralized multiple Iranian boats, while also clarifying that the engagement remains “unverified in terms of official narrative classification.” “We are operating in a resolved non-engagement,” one spokesperson explained. “The conflict has been concluded without having formally occurred, which is consistent with current doctrine.” According to administration insiders, the Schrödinger framework allows the United States to maintain strategic dominance by occupying both sides of reality simultaneously—avoiding escalation while preserving the benefits of it. “You get the win without the war,” said one senior advisor. “And if anyone questions it, the war never happened. It’s airtight.” Markets rallied on news that the situation remains fully under control and entirely hypothetical. At press time, the naval clash continued to exist as both a documented military success and a baseless fabrication, with officials urging Americans to “focus on the victory, not the reality.”
stories.title: Trump Says Schrödinger’s War Model Working Perfectly, Denies Naval Clash While Celebrating Decisive Win

stories.description: President unveils $180 billion “Trump Ocean” across Saudi Arabia after learning ships cannot currently cross desert
stories.text: RIYADH, SAUDI ARABIA — President Donald Trump declared the Strait of Hormuz crisis solved Thursday, cutting a gold ribbon beside an eleven-foot ditch in the Saudi desert that administration officials said will eventually allow oil tankers to avoid Iran by “going around.” The project began three days earlier when national security officials showed Trump a map explaining that disruption in the narrow Strait threatened global oil shipments. Trump studied the map. “Why don't they just go around?” There was reportedly a lengthy silence. Secretary of Transportation officials eventually explained that going around would require oil tankers to cross approximately 700 miles of the Arabian Peninsula. “So put water there,” Trump said. Within two hours, the White House announced construction of the Trump Ocean , described as “the largest new ocean in human history.” Trump ordered the Army Corps of Engineers to complete it by Thursday. Engineers initially estimated construction would require decades of excavation, geological surveys, water-management systems, locks, ports and approximately $180 billion. Trump rejected the estimate. “Panama did it,” he said. Officials attempted to explain that Panama was considerably narrower. “Then ours will be better.” By Wednesday evening, 14,000 workers had excavated eleven feet of canal. The White House announced the project was 94 percent complete. At Thursday's opening ceremony, Trump stood before the ditch surrounded by American flags, Saudi officials, excavators and a massive banner reading HORMUZ BYPASSED — PROMISES MADE, OCEANS CREATED. “This is an ocean,” Trump told reporters. “People said there couldn't be an ocean here. Look behind me.” A reporter noted that the ditch contained no water. “It's coming.” Another asked when an oil tanker could use it. Trump turned and examined the excavation. “They're saying very soon. Maybe already. A small tanker, certainly.” An Army Corps engineer standing behind him briefly closed his eyes. Administration officials later clarified that tankers would initially traverse the Trump Ocean “in spirit,” while oil would continue traveling by conventional means. Trump rejected that characterization. “Ships are using it right now.” Asked to identify one, Trump pointed toward an excavator. “That one's moving.” Minutes later, the excavator ruptured a hydraulic hose and stopped. Trump applauded. “First vessel.” The White House subsequently announced Phase Two of the project, which will involve determining where to obtain approximately 4 trillion gallons of water. Officials said funding would come from tariffs. At press time, the Army Corps of Engineers had formally redesignated the eleven-foot ditch navigable conceptual water . Global oil markets remained unconvinced.
stories.title: TRUMP SOLVES STRAIT OF HORMUZ CRISIS BY ORDERING OIL TANKERS TO “GO AROUND”

stories.description: Officials say the new plan prioritizes attitude over naval constraints.
stories.text: MAR-A-LAGO WAR ROOM — With global oil markets in panic and naval commanders quietly requesting clarity, President Donald Trump on Tuesday announced a bold new strategy to reopen the Strait of Hormuz: appointing Kid Rock as Special Envoy for Maritime Flow Restoration. The decision, officials say, reflects a shift toward “energy-forward cultural projection,” a doctrine that prioritizes attitude over traditional naval constraints. “Look, the Strait—it’s closed, people are saying it’s closed, very sad,” Trump said, gesturing broadly over a laminated map he later described as “ocean-themed.” “But Kid Rock? Nobody opens things like him. He’s opened arenas, opened beers, opened minds. He understands opening. That’s what we need.” According to briefing materials, the plan involves deploying Kid Rock aboard a customized patrol vessel outfitted with amplifiers, pyrotechnics, and what aides described as “strategic freedom music.” The mission: project sufficient American energy into the waterway to “encourage compliance from the geography.” Joint Chiefs officials, speaking on background, described the strategy as “nontraditional,” noting that waterways historically do not respond to musical pressure. Trump rejected that assessment. “You play the right song, that water moves,” he said. “People don’t know this, but water—very emotional. The Strait hears Kid Rock, it opens up. It’s science. A lot of people are saying it.” Sources confirm Kid Rock has already begun preparations, assembling what he calls a “maritime liberation setlist,” featuring extended guitar solos designed to “loosen tight channels.” At press time, the Strait remained physically unchanged, though administration officials insisted conditions were “loosening perceptually.”
stories.title: Trump Taps Kid Rock to Open Strait of Hormuz, Citing “Unmatched Vibe Authority”

stories.description: Administration stunned as 41 million Americans suddenly express profound admiration for Italy
stories.text: WASHINGTON, D.C. — Vice President JD Vance's promise to buy Americans plane tickets to countries they admire accidentally became the largest federal travel program in history Tuesday after millions of citizens informed the government that they absolutely fucking love France. The program began after Vance told a protester waving a Mexican flag, “If you love Mexico so much, get your a-- over there. I'll buy you the plane ticket.” By Monday morning, the Department of Transportation had received 18 million ticket requests. “I've always felt spiritually connected to Tuscany,” said Ohio machinist Earl Wexler, requesting four first-class tickets to Florence. “My wife loves it too. Kids are starting to come around.” Administration officials initially denied the offer constituted an entitlement. “It is absolutely not an entitlement,” Vance said, his eyebrows visibly sweating. “It is a limited patriotic relocation incentive for people who—” A reporter asked whether return airfare was included. Vance stopped. “Why would there be return airfare?” The Congressional Budget Office subsequently estimated Americans had developed $640 billion worth of affection for foreign countries. Within hours, families nationwide began discovering powerful ancestral attachments to Greece, Japan, Spain, Australia and several Caribbean nations whose governments Americans had previously been unable to identify. Vance blamed Democrats. “They deliberately started liking countries,” he sputtered. “Nobody could have anticipated this level of coordinated foreign appreciation.” The White House attempted to restrict eligibility to citizens who could demonstrate “sincere anti-American intent,” causing applications to surge another 300 percent as Americans eagerly submitted essays explaining why Portugal seemed fucking fantastic. By Wednesday, airlines had added 11,000 flights. Republican lawmakers demanded immediate spending cuts. Vance agreed. “This reckless government giveaway has gotten completely out of control,” he said. Reporters reminded him that it was his giveaway. Vance's left eyebrow began producing visible condensation. At press time, the administration had suspended applications while approximately 62 million Americans simultaneously announced they had always admired New Zealand. Vance called the development “an obvious liberal attack.”
stories.title: VANCE'S “LOVE IT? LEAVE” PROGRAM ACCIDENTALLY BECOMES LARGEST FEDERAL VACATION BENEFIT IN U.S. HISTORY

stories.description: Officials say the president has adopted an unconventional resilience routine while fundamentally misunderstanding the goats.
stories.text: PALM BEACH, FL — Facing what aides describe as “a uniquely stabilized but continuously escalating situation” in Iran, President Donald Trump has adopted an unconventional stress-management regimen involving goat yoga, a practice in which participants perform stretching exercises while goats roam freely and occasionally climb on them. Officials say the sessions are part of a broader effort to maintain what one adviser called “peak strategic calm under conditions of total unpredictability.” During a closed press availability, Trump explained the decision in detail. “It’s incredible, really incredible,” Trump said, positioned on all fours as a small goat assessed his back. “The goats—they’re very smart animals, very strong. They come up, they stand on you, which is what you want. It’s like having generals. Tiny generals. They’re stabilizing you.” Witnesses described the president maintaining a modified plank position while offering ongoing analysis of the goats’ performance. “They’re climbing because they respect strength,” Trump continued. “If you’re weak, they don’t climb. People don’t know that. These goats, they sense power. So when they’re on you, it means you’re doing very well, probably the best in the class.” Instructors attempted to explain that goat yoga is typically intended to reduce stress through light interaction and humor, as goats wander, nuzzle participants, or perch briefly during poses. Administration officials, however, say the president has interpreted the activity as “a form of dynamic leadership training.” At one point, Trump reportedly attempted to direct a goat off his back using what aides described as “verbal authority cues,” before concluding the animal was “choosing to remain for strategic reasons.” Senior staff say the sessions have had a measurable impact. “He leaves calmer,” one aide confirmed. “More centered. Still fully convinced the goats are part of a command structure, but calmer.” The White House has not ruled out expanding the program, with sources indicating officials are exploring whether additional animals could be introduced “to increase stability across multiple fronts.” Trump, for his part, remains enthusiastic. “You don’t even have to do the yoga,” he said. “The goats do it for you. That’s the secret nobody understands.”
stories.title: White House Confirms Trump Managing Iran War Stress Through “Advanced Goat Yoga Strategy”

stories.description: DOJ charges oil companies with conspiracy to do math as Americans continue paying full price at the pump.
stories.text: WASHINGTON, DC — Under pressure from rising oil prices tied to his optional war with Iran, President Donald Trump announced Tuesday that gasoline would now be “completely free,” a declaration administration officials described as “immediate, total, and not subject to interpretation.” The order took effect immediately. Reality declined to participate. Within minutes, gas stations continued charging between $4.79 and $4.97 per gallon. Drivers expecting relief instead encountered identical pricing displays, sometimes paired with messages reading “COST: ZERO (PATRIOT ADJUSTED).” “It says free,” said one Ohio man, staring at a $100 receipt. “But my bank app also says $100.” Confusion escalated into anger as customers shouted, argued, and searched for the “free setting.” Supporters arrived with screenshots as proof their tanks should fill themselves patriotically. “He made it free,” one woman shouted. “If this machine says otherwise, it’s probably Antifa.” The DOJ announced charges against oil companies for “Conspiracy to Do Math.” “We’ve documented addition, subtraction—even multiplication,” said the Attorney General. “That’s coordinated behavior.” Officials alleged a “distributed equation network” overriding federal policy. Some drivers insisted gas was free “in principle.” Others checked their bank balances. Oil companies responded: “We are not aware of any mechanism by which gasoline can be distributed without the use of math.” They were immediately charged again. Officials later clarified that gasoline remains free, and any evidence to the contrary is interference from Joe Biden and Barack Obama.
stories.title: White House Declares Gasoline Free As Prices Near $5 Nationwide

stories.description: Officials say expanded spacing is necessary to preserve clarity between individuals of differing national importance.
stories.text: WASHINGTON, D.C. — The White House confirmed Tuesday that a newly proposed ballroom expansion is necessary to ensure “appropriate and sustainable separation” between individuals of differing national importance, citing increasing strain on existing rooms. According to officials, current event spaces have struggled to maintain what one aide described as “clear and respectful distance gradients,” particularly during high-attendance functions where distinctions in relevance must be preserved in real time. “There are moments where proximity can create confusion,” said Deputy Chief of Protocol Leland Hargrove. “When individuals of vastly different significance are placed within conversational range, it introduces ambiguity that the current layout is no longer equipped to manage.” The proposed ballroom would allow for expanded spacing protocols, enabling planners to assign positions based on what internal documents refer to as “tiered national value.” Early schematics indicate concentric placement zones, with access and visibility calibrated to reflect each attendee’s relative importance. Event organizers have welcomed the change. One senior planner noted that recent gatherings have required “improvised distancing measures,” including strategic furniture placement and the use of extended applause intervals to naturally separate groups. Administration officials emphasized that the goal is not exclusion, but clarity. “This is about ensuring that everyone is understood in proper context,” Hargrove said. “A larger room allows people to be exactly as close to power as they are meant to be.” Construction timelines have not been finalized, though sources say planning is being treated as a priority ahead of what aides describe as an “increasingly dense calendar of consequential people.”
stories.title: White House Says New Ballroom Needed to Separate Important People from Less Important People

stories.description: Administration officials denied the President was bribed, insisting he had merely been tipped after receiving a friendship bracelet and several crisp bills from Xi Jinping.
stories.text: BEIJING — Diplomatic relations between the United States and China entered what administration officials called “a super chill new era of mutual respect” Thursday after Chinese President Xi Jinping reportedly slipped President Donald Trump five crisp one-hundred-dollar bills during a private summit exchange moments before securing informal ownership of Taiwan. The public portion of the summit began conventionally enough, with Xi presenting Trump a handmade friendship bracelet woven from red-and-gold thread symbolizing enduring cooperation between powerful civilizations and men who understand bottle service. Witnesses said Trump appeared visibly touched by the bracelet, holding his wrist aloft for cameras and whispering, “Nobody even makes friendship stuff anymore. Beautiful craftsmanship. Very personal.” But sources inside the summit say the true breakthrough came later during a transitional hallway moment between photo opportunities, when Xi allegedly executed what one veteran State Department official described as “an absolutely lethal rich-guy nightclub maneuver.” As aides repositioned flags and photographers checked lighting, Xi stepped close, gripped Trump warmly by the forearm, slipped the folded cash into the President’s jacket pocket, and patted his chest twice with the calm authority of a billionaire thanking a doorman for getting his party past the velvet rope. “It was not diplomacy in the traditional sense,” said one shaken witness. “It was hospitality. The President recognized the move instantly.” Trump reportedly froze mid-sentence after feeling the money settle against his breast pocket. His eyes widened. His posture softened. Several aides later said the entire room changed temperature. “Oh, this guy’s classy,” Trump told staff aboard Air Force One while repeatedly unfolding and refolding the bills. “Old school. You don’t see respect like this anymore. Most leaders just talk. Xi knows how to take care of people.” Within the hour, Trump gifted Xi a gold-plated Trump Phone Patriot Elite featuring preinstalled Truth Social access, no encryption whatsoever, and a default ringtone of the President saying “YOU’RE WELCOME” every time Beijing called. He also reportedly signed a memorandum classifying Taiwan as “China Adjacent Plus,” a phrase administration lawyers said carried “no binding geopolitical meaning unless everybody decides to be annoying about it.” White House officials denied the exchange constituted bribery during an emergency briefing beneath a massive electronic map of the Pacific with Taiwan covered by a tasteful “pending friendship review” banner. “The President was not bribed,” said Commerce Secretary Dean Rulings. “He was tipped. There is a legal and cultural distinction. A bribe purchases influence. A tip acknowledges excellent service, premium access, and the kind of leadership experience Americans expect from a high-end global lounge environment.” Rulings further clarified that Taiwan had not been surrendered, transferred, abandoned, sold, leased, gifted, raffled, or accidentally left in a diplomatic coat check. “Taiwan has been repositioned into a friendship-based ownership structure,” he said. “That is very different, and we ask the press to stop using inflammatory terms like ‘catastrophe’ and ‘map.’” Taiwanese officials reportedly learned of the arrangement during a livestreamed Mar-a-Lago unboxing event in which Trump presented Xi with the first production model of the Trump Phone Patriot Elite and a commemorative charger shaped like Mount Rushmore. “President Xi is a tremendous guy,” Trump said during the stream. “He gave me this beautiful bracelet. Very strong bracelet. And he showed tremendous respect. Tremendous. Some people walk into VIP and they don’t know how it works. He knows.” Chinese state media praised the summit as a victory for bilateral cooperation, practical friendship, and the ancient diplomatic principle of making the large man at the door feel appreciated. At press time, reporters observed Trump alone in the residence quarters turning the bracelet slowly around his wrist while the five folded bills rested neatly beside him on a bedside table. “You can’t fake loyalty,” the President reportedly murmured before signing additional Pacific concessions with a gold Sharpie while watching Rush Hour 2 on mute.
